414: Saya's twin sister and the story's main antagonist. She provides the Delta67 (derived from her blood) which is used to transform people into Chiropterans. When she was born she was kept in an isolated tower as part of an experiment.
836: Saya is the main protagonist in the series Blood + who hunts chiropterans using a katana. It is implied that she is the last remaining vampire and called "the only remaining original.
837: Riku is the adopted brother of Kai and Saya, the youngest of George Miyagusuku's three adopted children. He is a very kind and intelligent boy who loves to cook.
838: Saya's adopted "elder" brother. Once a popular student at school and a star athlete, he quits playing baseball shortly before Saya's arrival and has been getting into more fights at school. His father's death forces him to grow up and try his best keep his family united.
848: Joel Goldschmidt, current head of the Red Shield. His "diary" is a record of Red Shield's activities since its formation, and also contains information regarding Saya, Diva, the Chevaliers and the Chiroptera.
849: He is partly instrumental in Saya's "awakening" and his right arm is covered in bandages, hiding some Chiropteran features that he is unable to change back into human form. This might be due to trauma when Saya sliced his hand during the Vietnam incident.
850: Kaori is Saya's best friend in Okinawa, a kind-hearted and generous girl.
851: Before joining Red Shield, David was the sole survivor of a chiropteran attack on his special forces squad. His father was also a member of Red Shield and was one of Saya's victims in the Vietnam incident.
852: An Okinawan-American US Army veteran who served in the Vietnam War, George is one of the soldiers present when Saya goes insane in Vietnam, killing friends and enemies alike.
853: Joel is the founder of Red-shield
854: Irène fights with a wide, double-sided sword, and is one of several Schiff with the ability to locate Saya from great distances. Killing humans to drink their blood bothers her to the point that she refuses to continue to do so, though it leaves her in a weakened state.
856: Van Argiano is the head scientist studying chiropterans for Cinq Flèches. He was in charge of the development of Delta 67, working under Solomon and with his assistant Archer.
862: Anna Marie is considered to be the most stuck up girl in the Vietnamese school by many of her classmates. She takes pleasure in being a top student and being liked by the teacher. She considers herself to be very beautiful also.
863: Is the same monk involved in the historical downfall of Romanov dynasty of Russia. He was killed in 1916 in a long and drawn out assassination attempt that, among other things, saw him poisoned, stabbed, shot, and thrown into a freezing river.
864: Another Red Shield operative. He is often responsible for the gadgets and transportation for the operations. He makes many of the meals and also provides most of the comic relief. He can be spotted fighting alongside with David on several operations.
865: A strong-willed and stubborn schoolmate of Kai, Mao, the daughter of the head of the Jahana Yakuza, is often bossy and likes to be in control, a trait she probably picked up from her father.
866: 1st Brother, French/Jewish - Amshel Goldsmith, London stockbroker. (appearance age 44) He tries to bring Saya to their side at first, killing Liza and assuming her form to reveal Saya her true nature.
867: CEO of Cinq Flèches Group, and Amshel's younger brother from Amshel's original human family.
868: Moses is the leader of the Schiff, and the one who encouraged them to break out of the lab in Khirbet. He is calm and rational, and often chastises Karman, whom he has an ambiguous friendship with.
869: James Ironside is one of Diva's Chevaliers and Naval co-captain, he regards Diva as his "mother". His chiropteran form makes his skin as hard as steel. James has a pronounced hatred of the Schiff, whom he feels are inferior creatures.
870: Nathan works as one of Diva's Chevalier, though his actual origins as a Chevalier are quite ambiguous. He displays quite flamboyant behaviour at times, but can be calculated and ruthless if need be.
871: Lulu is an overtly idealistic member of the Schiff who is eventually taken in by Saya and friends.
872: Professor Aston Collins was once the second-in-command of the Red Shield, primarily in charge of researching the chiroptera with Julia as his assistant. He grew increasingly frustrated at being unable to ever publish his research.
873: Angry and bitter because of his experiences in Khirbet, Karman despises all humans and is often chastised for it by Moses, the leader of the Schiff. Karman is very aggressive and rash. He has a deep friendship with Moses but is also very caring for his comrades.
886: Gudrif is one of the Schiffs but not long enough on screen to really know much of him. When the Phantom Warriors their appears he gets badly wounded and decides to die by the heat of the sunlight as most of his friends did.
887: Darth is a member of the Schiff.
894: Min is a friend of Saya whom she meets in vietnam at Lycee. She is very talkative and spirited. She has a very strong desire for love and relationships and quickly becomes close to Saya.
958: A girl who has lost her leg from an unexploded bomb becomes a dear friend of Kai and Riku. She has a talent to play the piano and was going to attend a school in France but because her family is poor she cannot go. She has a strong desire to help her family anyway possible.
959: Julia Silverstein is a doctor working with the Red Shield organization.
3756: Karl (aka: The Phantom) is one of Diva's Chevalier and the chairman of the all girls school in Vietnam that Saya attends. He is later revealed to be the mysterious phantom of the school who gives out blue roses to his victims.
10620: Member of a Red Shield squad.
